claims.statement: On Nov18 China Gas said it replaced September 500000 t/y agreement with a 20-year 1 million t/y Venture Global LNG deal; earliest delivery 2030, not today.
China Gas reports the new agreement lifts its long-term LNG contracted portfolio to 4 million tons/year; a portfolio is not physical delivery.
ADNOC L&S confirmed on Nov18 that its vessel was attacked in Hormuz on Nov17 with one crew member missing and eleven injured; other Iranian broader tanker-burning claims are unverified.
API data reported Nov18 for the week ending Nov13 show US crude stocks up 5.28 million barrels, gasoline up 5.12m, and distillates up 0.351m; these are privately reported weekly figures.
Reuters attributed weaker WTI relative to Brent to constrained arbitrage to Asia and northwest Europe alongside US Gulf crude stock builds; this does not imply all maritime passage is open.
